download_mmmg_dataset: download the MMMG dataset from HuggingFace to a specified data directory with optional force flag
load_mmmg_prompts: load MMMG prompts from cached Arrow files using memory mapping and return a dictionary of prompt data
create_mmmg_lookup_key: create a lookup key string from a prompt id and category for indexing MMMG prompts
extract_mmmg_images: extract and save images from MMMG dataset prompts to disk as RGB JPEG files
parse_mmmg_prompt_content: parse MMMG instruction text to extract alternating text and image placeholder segments
